old: the Buddha and Mahavira preach in the kingdoms of the Ganges plain, where Magadha is rising
new: Magadha is rising among the kingdoms of the Ganges plain, where the Buddha and Mahavira lived and taught around this time (their exact dates are debated)

new: having ceded Arachosia, the Paropamisadae (Kabul region) and probably Gedrosia to Chandragupta
